title: Checklist
---

## Data linkage checklist

| Stage | Question | Why it matters | Read next |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pre-linkage | Have identifiers been standardised and profiled for missingness? | Dirty identifiers dominate false non-matches. | [Identifiers](theory/02-identifiers.qmd) |
| Pre-linkage | Is the linkage question clear about units, time, and expected multiplicity? | Matching people, events, and organisations leads to different rules. | [Why link?](theory/01-why-link.qmd) |
| Linkage | Are blocking rules wide enough to keep plausible matches? | Over-tight blocks can remove true matches before scoring. | [Blocking](theory/03-blocking.qmd) |
| Linkage | Are comparison fields weighted in line with their error structure? | Rare, stable identifiers should usually count more. | [Comparison](theory/04-comparison.qmd) |
| Linkage | Are decision thresholds and clerical review rules explicit? | Hidden judgement makes results hard to audit. | [Decisions](theory/05-decisions.qmd) |
| Post-linkage | Have precision, recall, or proxy diagnostics been reported? | Linkage quality affects downstream bias. | [Evaluation](theory/06-evaluation.qmd) |
| Reporting | Have governance, privacy, and reporting standards been documented? | Reviewers need to know how linkage was done and constrained. | [Reporting](theory/07-reporting.qmd) |
